title: Pan-Seared Japanese Greens with Kenyan Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared greens and a side of Kenyan-spiced pilaf.

ingredients.name: greens (such as bok choy or collard greens)

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pan-seared greens to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until tender and slightly browned.
Remove the greens from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and stir in the Kenyan pilaf.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the pilaf is heated through and starting to brown.
Return the pan-seared greens to the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
Optional: add a sprinkle of sesame seeds or chopped green onions for garnish.
